criteria.dedupe: by stream URL (url_resolved preferred); when entries share one, the most-voted is kept
criteria.urls: public http(s) addresses only: no credentials, no localhost or private-network hosts
criteria.genres: stations with more than 15 tags are left out of genre playlists
criteria.ets2: per country, up to 100 most-voted MP3 or Ogg stations as a live_streams.sii for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator; AAC, playlist addresses and https on ports other than 443 are left out
